newsitem.title: USA: Banca Serfin to get note for loans.
newsitem.headline: Banca Serfin to get note for loans.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Serfin said on Tuesday the Fondo Bancario de Proteccion al Ahorra agreed to acquire mortgage loans from its Banca Serfin in exchange for a 10-year note.

The mortgage loans had a face value of 10,300 million pesos, the company said. Banca Serfin would pay 2,000 million pesos in cash of reserves to Fondo Bancario de Proteccion, or Fobaproa, and would record a charge against capital in the same amount, the company said.
To offset this capital charge, Fondo Bancario de Proteccion al Ahorro would acquire about 2,000 million pesos of Grupo Financiero Serfin common stock at market value, it said.
Grupo Financiero would contribute these funds to the capital of Banca Serfin, the company said.
The sale of loans were part of Fondo Bancario de Proteccion al Ahorro's support for Banca Serfin's efforts to reach an agreement with a strategic partner, the company said.
